items.title: Ukrainian officials say Starshield restrictions still in place, despite Trump’s claims
items.brief: US President Donald Trump on Thursday claimed that Elon Musk had restored Ukraine’s access to a military-grade version of his Starlink internet service, called Starshield, but Ukrainian officials have said…

items.title: At least 7 people killed in shooting at church in Jordan, state media says
items.brief: At least 7 people were killed after armed men opened fire inside a church in Jordan’s Karak province, Jordanian state media said.

items.title: US tourist in Italy falls 1,000 feet to death on mountain hike
items.brief: A Florida woman died after plunging more than 300 meters (around 1,000 feet) while hiking in the Italian Dolomite mountains , according to police in the northern city of Trentino .

items.title: Man accused of beheading Iwo Jima statue in Virginia with sledgehammer
items.brief: The Battle of Iwo Jima monument in Quantico, Virginia, has suffered hundreds of thousands of dollars in damages after a man beheaded one of the statues Wednesday evening, police said.

items.title: Meghan ‘deeply distressed’ over child sex abuse image allegations against father
items.brief: Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, said Friday she was “deeply distressed” by a report that her father had a large collection of images depicting child sex abuse and revealed she had been told of “disturbing allegations”…

items.title: Netanyahu orders closure of West Bank after five Israelis wounded in shooting attack
items.brief: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the closure of the occupied West Bank after two Palestinian gunmen opened fire Friday on an Israeli military checkpoint, killing two soldiers.

items.title: One killed, four injured in drive-by shooting near Paris
items.brief: One person was killed and at least four others were injured in a shooting in the Yvelines district west of Paris, and a suspect has been arrested, French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said on Friday.
